channel.title: Bach Thai Khang — Architectural Portfolio
channel.description: Architecture student portfolio — Hanoi University of Architecture, IITC program. Featuring school projects, real-world design work, and urban planning.

item.title: Si Pa Phin School — Concept Design
item.description: A three-level school (Primary – Lower Secondary – Upper Secondary) in Si Pa Phin commune, Dien Bien. Designed for 31 classrooms serving over 1,000 students. The campus includes modern classrooms, a boarding facility, multi-purpose hall, library, sports field, and swimming pool.

item.title: Middle School 1B — Co Nhue, Bac Tu Liem
item.description: Concept design for a 3,900 m² middle school in Co Nhue Ward, Bac Tu Liem District. Full design with gymnasium block, connecting corridors, and landscaping system.

item.title: Indochine Restaurant — Facade Design
item.description: Redesigned the facade of an Indochine-style restaurant — blending traditional materials with a contemporary architectural language. Includes site plan, ground and second-floor layouts.

item.title: Phuc Minh Khang Multi-Level School — Studio 04
item.description: Full school complex design — integrating landscape, functional zoning, and a contemporary facade. Advisor: Arch. Tran Nguyen Quang, Sunjin Vietnam.

item.title: Van Quan Lake Urban Design — Urban Q3
item.description: Lakeside urban design — walkways, public amenities, and green-corridor intersections. 3.2 hectares masterplan in Ha Dong district.

item.title: Old Quarter House Renovation — Studio 02
item.description: Renovating a house in a Hanoi Old Quarter alley — optimising light flow, ventilation, and living spaces within a 4m-wide footprint. Advisor: M.Arch. Eytan Fichman, IITC.

item.title: AI Facade Ideation — Before/After
item.description: Applied AI tools to facade design ideation — transforming a blank 3D mass into a full architectural proposal with materials, colours, and landscaping for Lotus Grand Hotel.
